last.verdict: Pfizer raised 2026 guidance on strong Eliquis and new-drug sales, but flat quarterly revenue shows COVID and vaccine declines still weigh.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B, and EPS to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, driven by Eliquis and newer drugs.

takeaways.label: Eliquis and new drugs
takeaways.text: Eliquis grew 25% on lower rebates and higher demand. Launched and acquired products rose 32%, and non-COVID sales rose 7%. Padcev jumped 55%.

takeaways.label: COVID and vaccines drag
takeaways.text: Revenue was flat at $16.6B. Paxlovid fell 63%, Comirnaty 29% and Prevnar 10% on lower vaccination rates and shrinking adult share.

takeaways.label: Obesity and patent cliff
takeaways.text: Pfizer targets a first approval for its monthly obesity drug in 2028. It also added $2.5B of 2027-2029 cost cuts to cushion coming patent expiries.

history.verdict: Earnings beat and a higher revenue outlook gave shares a modest lift.

reasons.label: Beat on profit
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.77 beat the roughly $0.68 analysts expected; revenue was $15.0B.

reasons.label: Revenue outlook raised
reasons.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $500M at the midpoint, to $60.5-$62.5B.

reasons.label: COVID sales shrinking
reasons.text: COVID product sales forecast cut to about $4B from $5B, capping enthusiasm.
